mapper.sql: transaction_id AS transactionId, business_key AS businessKey, request_payload::text AS requestPayload, status, order_id AS orderId, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_transaction_record ( transaction_id, business_key, request_payload, status, order_id, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{transactionId}, #{businessKey}, CAST(#{requestPayload} AS JSONB), 'PREPARED', #{orderId}, #{lastError}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_transaction_record SET status = 'COMMITTED', order_id = #{orderId}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'PREPARED'
UPDATE mq_transaction_record SET status = 'ROLLED_BACK', last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'PREPARED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mq_transaction_record WHERE status = 'PREPARED' AND order_id IS NULL AND created_at <= #{expiredBefore} ORDER BY created_at ASC, transaction_id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
